newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill falls to 10.12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill falls to 10.12 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Wednesday it set a cut-off price of 90.83 rupees at its fortnightly auction of 364-day treasury bills, up from 90.64 rupees at the previous auction.
Dealers said the yield worked out to 10.12 percent, down from the previous auction's 10.35 percent.
The RBI said it received 59 bids for 18.87 billion rupees of which it accepted 14 for 6.35 billion.
